findings.desc: DEV implementation discovered existing Koala lifecycle command dev_start is already used by INIT_CHECK/worktree bootstrap. CHK-005 currently specifies dev_start as the new agent wrapper, which would collide with lifecycle behavior. Re-plan required: preserve existing dev_start and rename wrapper to dev_memory_start or equivalent non-conflicting command.

docs reviewer: dev_memory_finish section says it works in three modes but then describes four behaviors by splitting explicit --storyId into its own mode; --storyId should read as a target override for the story-candidate path, not a separate operating mode.

docs reviewer: dev_memory_start is described as prompt-only but docs/CLI copy do not explicitly distinguish it from existing lifecycle dev_start; near-identical names leave naming-collision ambiguity for readers.

REVIEW→TEST gate incorrectly treats main-agent authored findings as reviewer evidence because collectReviewerEvidenceState filters agent != main instead of requiring koala-review-* lanes. Existing resolved F-001 was created by main-agent during DEV and now blocks TEST due missing reviewRunId, even though it is not reviewer evidence. Fix gate classification and add regression coverage so only koala-review-* findings/passes require reviewRunId binding.
